title: FDI, greener technology and post-Paris foreign acquisition

source.request: Does FDI transmit greener technologies, and did this become stronger after Paris?
source.notes: Brucal, Javorcik & Love menggunakan older SI dan menemukan foreign acquisition menurunkan energy intensity sekitar 30%, meski total energy meningkat karena scale expansion.

question: Does a verified foreign acquisition change a factory’s environmental performance, and do post-Paris acquisitions differ?
rationale: Distinguish a real ownership event from a recorded 10% foreign-capital threshold crossing, then compare cohorts at the same event horizon.
scope: Full exact Word row, interpreted through repository minimum checks and current owner full-plan ning/full-row acceptance gates. All analysis below is planned, not executed.
unit_of_analysis: Verified continuing establishment-year with source-validated domestic-to-foreign acquisition events.

target_estimands.name: Primary requested target
target_estimands.formula: ATT_k^a = E[q_i,g+k(1)-q_i,g+k(0) | verified acquisition at g, cohort era=a]; Delta_k = ATT_k^post - ATT_k^pre

symbols.i: a verified establishment, never a row-number or artificial linkage
symbols.V: value added deflated with a certified appropriate price index; any single-output-deflator approximation is named
symbols.Y: gross output deflated with its certified output-price index
symbols.E: scope-defined verified physical energy in GJ; incomplete observed subtotals are separately named
symbols.C: scope-defined verified CO2 in metric tonnes; not automatically all greenhouse gases
symbols.L: workers under an annually verified employment definition
symbols.X: predetermined measured covariates declared for the particular design
symbols.g: verified treatment-entry cohort in calendar years
symbols.S: a verified trade, ownership, industry, or survival state; unknown is retained as unknown
symbols.a: pre-Paris or post-Paris acquisition cohort era
symbols.Delta_k: post-era minus pre-era acquisition ATT at common horizon
symbols.q(1),q(0): outcomes with acquisition and the stated untreated counterfactual

target_estimands.interpretation: The first estimand concerns acquisition under the event-study assumptions. The post-minus-pre difference compares acquisition cohorts; it is not by itself the effect of Paris.
target_estimands.limits: Targets of foreign acquisition are selected. A foreign-share threshold is not necessarily a transfer of control. Lower intensity with higher total energy is not proof of a particular green technology.
